preconditions.description: The number of genes G must be greater than 2.
The number of rows in the mutation table N must be at least G - 2.
The number of antibodies M must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G and k >= 1 for a, k in mutation_table)
preconditions.description: Each mutation table entry must have a valid gene index a and a positive length k.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i < G for b_i in mutation_table_values)
preconditions.description: All gene indices in the mutation table values must be valid.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l and all(0 <= c_i <= 1 for c_i in antibody) for l, antibody in antibodies)
preconditions.description: Each antibody must have a valid length and only contain binary values.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if all viruses can be detected, otherwise output 'NO' followed by the minimal length of an undetectable virus.
